semiconductor_relevance: High — RIKEN KEIKI specializes in gas detection and environmental measurement products critical for safety in semiconductor fabrication facilities.
summary: RIKEN KEIKI Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of gas detection systems tailored for semiconductor fabs, offering over a hundred models designed to ensure safety and compliance. Their innovative products, such as the Multi-point Toxic Gas Detection System, are essential for monitoring hazardous gases and maintaining safe working environments.

regional_presence.Japan: RIKEN KEIKI has maintained a market share of over 70% in semiconductor fabs in Japan for over 40 years.
